short_summary: Erasmia: 0 of 21 combos reached 3. All 71 crawler candidates across every combo (attorneys, automotive, beauty, building, catering, retail, hardware, printing, recruitment, restaurants, software, solar, spas, etc.) were national chains, dictionary/definition pages, directory search pages or unrelated content with no Erasmia-specific match -- none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar, so nothing was published.

Olievenhoutbosch: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 46 crawler candidates were generic/national results (chains, dictionary pages, unrelated junk) with no Olievenhoutbosch-specific business found; none cleared the verification bar.
Heuweloord: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 47 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar.
Ninapark: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 43 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.
Centurion Central: 0 of 11 combos reached 3. All 37 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.
Faerie Glen: 0 of 7 combos reached 3. All 20 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.

Sunnyside: 0 of 5 combos reached 3. All 18 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar. Note across the whole batch-04 run: search results were unusually degraded (Brave consistently 429-blocked, Bing/DDG often returning off-topic or wrong-country/wrong-city content for hyperlocal queries) -- likely heavy concurrent load from the many parallel discover-fill agents sharing the same search engines right now. This looks like a tooling/contention issue rather than genuine absence of businesses in these suburbs; a re-run under lighter load may do better.

The Willows: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 62 crawler candidates (accountants, attorneys, beauty, books, building, clinics, fashion, financial services, general retail, hardware, hotels, logistics, marketing, nurseries, printing, solar, supermarkets) were national chains/online retailers, dictionary/definition pages or entirely unrelated results (Stack Overflow, GitHub, a Chinese-language forum) with zero Willows- or even Pretoria-specific matches; none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar.

De Wilgers: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 60 crawler candidates (books, car dealerships, clinics, computer/IT, doctors, electronics, estate agents, general retail, insurance, pest control, printing, restaurants, schools, security, solar, spas) were national/online retailers or unrelated content; the only phones parsed belonged to a Johannesburg attorney (011) and a Cape Town doctor practice (021), neither a De Wilgers branch. None cleared the verification bar.

Wolmer: 0 of 14 combos reached 3. All 50 crawler candidates (business consulting, butcheries, computer/IT, general retail, hardware, industrial suppliers, liquor, logistics, marketing, motor spares, nurseries, printing, security, software) were national chains/online results with no Wolmer-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Irene: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 45 crawler candidates (accountants, books, butcheries, car dealerships, commercial property, computer/IT, engineering, events venues, financial services, furniture, logistics, restaurants, security) were national/online results or wrong-location Facebook posts (an Emfuleni municipality page, unrelated to Irene/Centurion); none cleared the verification bar.

Andeon: 0 of 10 combos reached 3. All 38 crawler candidates (business consulting, commercial property, engineering, financial services, furniture, general retail, hardware, printing, security, software) were national/online results with no Andeon-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Klerksoord: 0 of 7 combos reached 3. All 26 crawler candidates (automotive repairs, commercial property, furniture, general retail, marketing, motor spares, solar) were national/online results with no Klerksoord-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Onderstepoort: 0 of 5 combos reached 3. All 17 crawler candidates (cleaning, industrial suppliers, schools, solar, vets) were national/online results with no Onderstepoort-specific match. Batch-06 totals: 0 of 83 combos reached 3, 0 businesses published, all 298 crawler candidates discarded as unverifiable. Strong, directly-confirmed contention signal (not suburb scarcity): a manual Brave Search request made mid-run returned HTTP 429 (blocked by anti-bot protection); a manual Bing test then showed the SAME top 3 results regardless of query -- a plain query, a quoted "The Willows" phrase, and a site:facebook.com filter all returned identical generic/global results, meaning Bing itself was serving degraded, query-independent output during this run. Under lighter search-engine load this suburb set likely has real, findable businesses; a re-run is recommended once contention eases.

Wierdapark: closed fashion-clothing (added Fashion Capsule and Ifateleng). 26 of 27 combos in this suburb stayed short -- crawler candidates were almost all national chains, dictionary/definition pages or unrelated content with no Wierdapark-specific presence; one candidate (Classique Outffiters) was discarded despite matching directory listings because its own Facebook page gave a different phone number than the directories.

Erasmuskloof: added PEAK Centre (sport medicine/dietetics/psychology/biokinetics practice, categorised Clinics & Healthcare rather than the Fitness & Gyms combo it was found under, since it is professional-led rehab/wellness, not a gym floor) and Trainingwithstef Pty Ltd t/a SteFIT (HYROX training club/personal trainer, Fitness & Gyms) -- both verified via own website + an independent SA directory, with phone and street address pinned to the exact address. First-pass generic category+suburb search returned almost entirely irrelevant results (dictionary definitions, national chains, forums) for Erasmuskloof's other ~18 combos; a second, directory-biased query pass is in progress to re-check those before giving up on them.

Doornpoort: closed estate-agents (Delcor Real Estates) and marketing-advertising (INTL Studios); partially filled electronics-appliances (Nano Creations, still 1 short), insurance (BlueCare Insurance Brokers, still 1 short) and logistics-courier-transport (PostNet Doornpoort, still 1 short). 12 of 17 combos stayed at 0 -- raw crawler candidates were almost all irrelevant junk (ChatGPT/OpenAI pages, credit-report sites, dictionaries, piracy forums); most follow-up leads were discarded for wrong suburb (several businesses that directories placed in Doornpoort were actually in Pretoria North, Montana, Wonderboom or Derdepoort), missing/conflicting address or phone, single-source only, or being the same underlying business as an existing listing or another verified business this run (e.g. Bluecare Financial Services shares BlueCare Insurance Brokers' phone, so was not double-counted).

Lukasrand: 0 of 4 combos reached 3. Raw crawler candidates were national OTA/chain homepages and generic directories, all irrelevant. Follow-up leads were discarded because they turned out to be in a neighbouring suburb (guesthouses actually in Nieuw Muckleneuk/Sunnyside), were the same business as an existing listing under its full registered or junior-campus name (Rise Above Weakness Pty Ltd = existing RAW Gym; Crawford Preparatory Pretoria = same address as existing Crawford International Pretoria), or (one attorneys firm, Rudman Attorneys) had address+phone confirmed but no source describing what it actually practices, so a genuine non-padded description could not be written.

Equestria: added 7 new businesses (Travel Clinic Equestria, LTT Computer Solutions, Clicks Equestria, Al Madina Supermarket, Union Caterers, CIT Moto, Mzansi Afrika Consulting Services), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address. Discarded CJVH Estate Agent (no real address, templated suburb page), AD Care Group (phone fetch blocked, facility location ambiguous) and Absolute Pets Equestria (could not pin a phone to this branch specifically vs. its Grove Mall branch). A promising Pick n Pay Equestria candidate turned out to already be published under suburb the-willows (same phone) -- not added, not counted as discarded-unverified since it is real, just a boundary-suburb duplicate. Most of Equestria's other 11 combos (beauty, hardware, industrial suppliers, logistics, marketing, mobile phones, nurseries, opticians, software development) returned no candidate that cleared the 2-source + pinned-phone + pinned-address bar and remain short. Note on tooling: the shared discover-businesses.mjs crawler's engine order (brave, then bing, then lite.duckduckgo) was producing near-zero usable candidates across this batch -- Brave was already 429-rate-limited from other concurrent batches, and Bing's scrape was returning generic/irrelevant top-ranked pages (encyclopedia entries, national e-commerce sites, even unrelated pages) for small-suburb queries instead of falling through to lite.duckduckgo, which turned out to surface real local directory listings (procompare, cybo, africabizinfo, findglocal, pretoria.co.za, etc.) far more reliably. Re-ran discovery via a local copy (discover-businesses-v2.mjs) with lite.duckduckgo prioritised first, which is what produced usable candidates for this and subsequent checkpoints.

Muckleneuk/Accommodation combo closed to 3: added Muckleneuk Guest House (228 Cilliers Street) and Waterhouse Guest Lodge (236 & 230 Bourke Street), both 4-star B&Bs verified via their own site/Facebook plus an independent accommodation directory, phone+address pinned to the exact property. Other Muckleneuk combos checked so far (accountants, beauty, building, clinics, commercial property, computer/IT) found no candidate with both a working source and an address actually inside Muckleneuk -- brabys.com and infobel.co.za block individual listing pages (Cloudflare challenge / terms wall) so most of their candidates could not be read at all; cylex.net.za category pages often blend in neighbouring suburbs. Still working through the rest of this suburb.

Willow Park Manor: added 5 new businesses on or near Havelock Road's Co Space business park (TNC Consulting Engineers, Sila Digital Printing, BusinessPrint, GLORY ROOM Boutique, Computer Guardian), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address; this closes computer-it-services and printing-services (2 added against a need of 1) to 3. Discarded Kanya Sonke Cleaning Services (one source placed it in Nellmapius, not Willow Park Manor -- conflicting location), Funken Electrical (the business's own Facebook page says Green Street, Johannesburg, contradicting a cybo.com listing's Willow Park Manor address -- trusted the primary source and discarded), Pretoria Natural Hair Salon (no phone found, and search suggested the salon may trade under a different registered name) and RAW Auto Works (only one source -- its own site -- confirms the Willow Park Manor address; a second source filed it under 'equestria_outlying' instead, so it was left out rather than risk a wrong suburb pin). A Shepherd Removals & Deliveries candidate (11 Havelock Ave, Willow Park Manor) was dropped after validate.mjs showed its phone already belongs to an existing business published under suburb midfields-estate -- a real business, just a boundary/chain duplicate, not counted as discarded-unverified. Most of the remaining 10 combos (accountants, attorneys, automotive, beauty, catering, cleaning, commercial property, electricians, insurance, spas, supermarkets) stayed short.

Irene Farm Villages/Beauty & Hair Salons: added Cinnedene Studios (Shop 179, Basement, Irene Village Mall), a makeup/aesthetics/nails practice verified via its own site plus an independent beauty directory, still 1 short of 3. Also checked Eldoraigne's Building & Construction combo: discarded DTC Construction and GRM Roofing (both real, address+phone confirmed across 2-3 sources) because every source for each gave only a one-line directory bio with no real service detail beyond the category label -- not enough to write a genuine, non-padded 100+ word description. Business Consulting, Commercial Property, Engineering, Logistics, Pet Stores and Pharmacies (Irene Farm Villages) and most of Eldoraigne's remaining combos found nothing suburb-specific; Fitness/Nurseries candidates in this suburb turned out to be the existing BODYTEC/Irene Gardener's Nursery listings, not new businesses.

Laudium: closed hardware-stores (Munaf's Hardware), security-services (Triple Threat Security Solutions), computer-it-services (Cell Fix & Computer Repairs, K4 Computers), travel-agents (Harvey World Travel Laudium, Rajalaxmi Travel & Tours) and supermarkets-groceries (SPAR Kismet). Partially filled furniture-homeware (Jergens Beds Factory, 1 short), business-consulting (IBMC PM, 1 short) and printing-services (The Print & Computer Shop, 1 short -- a second candidate, PostNet Laudium, already exists in the snapshot filed under logistics-courier-transport, so it was not re-inserted; worth an admin adding that existing listing's category rather than treating this page as needing a new business). 5 of 13 combos stayed at 0 -- mostly wrong-suburb leads (a clothing retailer actually in Erasmia, shops actually in Boskruin/Centurion) or no confirmable second source/phone.

Heritage Hill Estate: partially filled beauty-hair-salons (Lavish Hair Artistry, a hair-colour specialist at The Courtyard -- confirmed distinct from the existing Lavish - You'll Love It, a different business at the Gatehouse), still 1 short. 8 of 9 combos stayed at 0 -- crawler candidates were almost entirely irrelevant junk (definitional articles, torrent sites, generic national directories); follow-ups for attorneys, schools and software all surfaced only the existing listings or businesses with no suburb-specific presence.

Hammanskraal: added 6 new businesses (5 Star Hardware, PEPcell, Kgatoentle Printing Works, Big Save Hammanskraal, MILO Printing, HomeX Furniture & Lifestyle), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address; this closes printing-services (need 2) and furniture-homeware and supermarkets-groceries (need 1 each) to 3. Discarded Makola General Dealer (a conflicting directory entry under the name Mahlogonolo General Dealer raised doubt about the real name/phone pairing), Hammanskraal Motor Spares (one source tied it to Winterveldt rather than Hammanskraal, and the only other lead sharing its phone was the existing AHK Motor Spares) and Hammanskraal Pharmacy (address confirmed on two directories but the phone number was only ever shown partially/truncated, never in full). General Retail, Mobile Phones (1 of 2 added) and Hardware Stores (1 of 2 added) remain short.

Montana/Restaurants & Takeaways closed to 3: added Burger Box Roadhouse Montana (drive-thru, Montana Corner Shopping Centre) and Mike's Kitchen Montana (Shop 17, Lifestyle Centre Building, Veronica Road), both chain branches verified via their own franchise site plus an independent Facebook business page, phone+address pinned to this exact branch (one source mislabelled Montana Corner's suburb as Magalieskruin; the franchise's own branch-locator page and the branch's own Facebook page both state Montana, which is used here as the primary/majority source). General Retail, Logistics and Pharmacies/Montana found no suburb-specific candidate. Eden Gardens Nursery (candidate for Nurseries/Waterkloof Park) was discarded: its real address is Waterkloof Ridge, a different suburb, not Waterkloof Park.

Roodeplaat: added 3 new businesses (Roodeplaat Dierekliniek, Die Poort Dierekliniek / Veterinary Clinic, Bushveld Pond), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address; this closes vets-animal-care (need 2) to 3. Discarded Roodeplaat Indigenous Nursery and Newlands Nursery (both had one source saying Roodeplaat but a second disagreeing -- Wallmannsthal/Mamelodi East for the first, a differently-named and differently-addressed 'Hilda's Newlands Wholesale Nursery' for the second -- so neither cleared the 2-source-agreeing bar). A second wedding-services candidate, BosBoma (Plot 92, Kameeldrift East), was dropped after validate.mjs showed its phone and address already belong to an existing business published under suburb kameeldrift -- a real venue, just a boundary/neighbouring-suburb duplicate, not counted as discarded-unverified; wedding-services stays 1 short. Industrial Suppliers & Manufacturing and Software Development (Roodeplaat) found no suburb-specific candidate.

Hennopspark: closed accountants (Fin5 Incorporated, LDR Accounting & Tax Solutions), cleaning-services (Wash and Go Cleaning Service Centurion), furniture-homeware (Rooidop Furniture, MB Pine & Furniture) and marketing-advertising (HALP! Media, Elite Signs & Branding). Partially filled electricians (Hybrid Electrical and Plumbing, 1 short), fitness-gyms (Bossie's Gym and Personal Training Studio, 1 short), pest-control (Kill Roach, 1 short) and solar-renewable-energy (GC Solar Retail Store, 1 short). security-services stayed short: a 'Monitor Net' candidate was found but shares its 0861 toll-free number with an existing Monitor Net listing already published under Blue Valley Golf Estate -- a shared national line, not pinned to this branch -- so it was not re-inserted. 5 of 15 combos (business-consulting, commercial-property-office-space, electronics-appliances, fashion-clothing, financial-investment-services, nurseries-garden-centres) stayed at 0, mostly branch-naming traps (a 'Concept Wealth Hennopspark' advisory whose real office is in Lynnwood Manor) or category mismatches (a garden-machinery dealer, not a plant nursery).

Waterkloof Glen: closed electronics-appliances (Capital Connection, Ultimus Electronics). Partially filled printing-services (Art of Print, sharing premises with the existing Outdoorphoto listing but a distinct business, 1 short). fuel-stations stayed short: a 'Caltex Waterkloof Glen' candidate shares its exact phone number with the existing Astron Energy Waterkloof Glen listing -- almost certainly the same station under its pre-rebrand Caltex name (Astron Energy acquired Chevron/Caltex's SA network) -- so it was not re-inserted as a separate business. 5 of 8 combos (commercial-property-office-space, hardware-stores, industrial-suppliers-manufacturing, insurance, logistics-courier-transport) stayed at 0 -- mostly wrong-suburb leads (Mica's nearest branch is Waterkloof Ridge, not Waterkloof Glen; a chemical manufacturer actually in Waltloo; a freight company actually in Sterrewag).

Eldoraigne/Spas & Wellness closed to 3: added Villa Thai Health Spa (1266 Willem Botha Drive) and Pure Bliss Day Spa and Mobile Spa (1275 Willem Botha Street), both verified with phone+address pinned to the exact Eldoraigne address via 2 independent sources each. This closes out Eldoraigne for this batch: Books & Stationery, Clinics & Healthcare, Electronics & Appliances, Engineering, Events & Function Venues, Fuel Stations, Industrial Suppliers, Printing Services, Restaurants, Solar and Supermarkets all stayed short -- candidates were either national chains/generic directory category pages with no Eldoraigne-specific listing, or (Fitness, Solar) turned out to be the existing BODYTEC Eldoraigne / OpenSky Solar businesses under a slightly different listing name, not new businesses.

Valhalla: 4 of 18 combos reached 3 (books-stationery, computer-it-services, electronics-appliances, motor-spares). Added 15 verified businesses (Mahdiyyah Patel Attorneys, Valhalla Book Exchange, Pro PC Stationery, El Lucido Cleaning, ELSA Support Services, Ryk's Electrical, Doolys Cell Phones, Fashion Express, Shoprite LiquorShop Valhalla, Viva Spares, Detronic Auto Electrical, Spartan Spares, Proton Solar Distributors, VS Travel and Tours, Ringpharm Osmans Pharmacy), each with 2+ independent sources, a real street address and a branch-specific phone. Discarded 49 candidates: one real find (a 'Valhalla Liquor Stores' listing) turned out to share its phone number with the already-published TOPS at SPAR Valhalla and was dropped as a likely duplicate under another name; the rest were national chains, generic Pretoria-wide directory aggregator pages, or candidates with no Valhalla-specific address. Confirmed search-engine contention directly: Brave returned HTTP 429 on every manual test query; Bing gave query-independent cached results for several manual probes (identical SERPs for different text) and completely unrelated decoy content for others (Google Chrome downloads, YouTube help pages, Lottostar, NamePros for South African local-business queries). Switched the crawl to query lite.duckduckgo.com first instead (dropping/deprioritising Brave and Bing), which is what actually surfaced all the verified businesses above -- this matches the engine-order fix the coordinator independently pushed to discover-businesses.mjs mid-run.

The Orchards: added 4 new businesses (Orchards Hyper Liquor, Orchards Liquor Market/Blue Bottle Liquors, Torenia Marketing, Thaluyami Consulting), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address; this closes liquor-stores (need 2, two genuinely different stores at different shopping centres) and accountants (need 1) to 3. A candidate called 'ORCHARDS PLAZA LIQUORS' turned out to be the same Shop 7, Orchards Plaza store as Orchards Liquor Market under a third trading-name variant, so it was not added as a separate business. Discarded Ntsako Security Services and Academy: its own brabys.com listing (whose URL named The Orchards) was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the only other source that loaded gave just a generic 'Pretoria' location, not clearing the 2-source-agreeing-on-location bar. Marketing & Advertising stays 1 short (need 2, only Torenia Marketing added); Building & Construction, Business & Management Consulting, Commercial Property & Office Space, Electricians, Hardware Stores, Pharmacies, Recruitment & HR Services, Schools & Education and Software Development found no suburb-specific candidate (several Building & Construction leads were a Johannesburg suburb of the same name, 'Orchards', wrongly surfaced by the crawler).

Eldoglen Estate's only combo (Restaurants & Takeaways, need 1) closed to 3: added RocoMamas Eldo Square, a Halaal-certified branch at Eldo Square Shopping Centre, verified via the franchise's own branch locator plus an independent delivery-platform listing agreeing on name and location. This was the last combo in batch-01. Claudius and Waterkloof Park (10 and 9 combos) ended at 0 published: candidates were either generic Pretoria-wide directory category pages with no listing actually inside the suburb, or (for Waterkloof Park's two legal/attorney leads) real firms whose confirmed address placed them in Nieuw Muckleneuk or plain Waterkloof -- a different suburb from Waterkloof Park -- so they were not used.
Silverton / Furniture & Homeware: added Double Click Furniture Silverton (Eastway Centre, Pretoria Road), verified against the business's own site plus 3 local directories. Combo now at 3.

Silverton: added Aurinia Ford Silverton and BB Nissan Silverton (Car Dealerships, combo now at 3), Cabanas Furniture & Appliance (2nd Furniture & Homeware add), Kotwals Motor Spares Silverton (Motor Spares, combo now at 3), and Silverton Stationery Warehouse (Books & Stationery, still 1 short of 3). Discarded TotalEnergies Silvertondale (address pins to Eersterust, not Silverton), Shireletsa Clinic and a Kilner Park pharmacy lead (conflicting phone/address across sources), and The Local Choice Pharmacy Silverton (its listed address duplicated an unrelated business's, looked like a default location pin).

Garsfontein Smallholdings: 0 of 15 combos reached 3. The snapshot lists 'garsfontein' and 'garsfontein-smallholdings' as two separate suburbs, and essentially every crawler candidate across insurance, jewellers, logistics, marketing, recruitment and security (Inn Focus, KDSA Logistics, Angelcy Brand Messengers, Great Creative Media, Social Time, Exclusive HR Consulting, Placement Dynamics, Don's Security Installations, etc.) only ever said plain 'Garsfontein' on every source checked, never 'Smallholdings' -- so none could be pinned to this exact suburb rather than its larger neighbour. Two re-run queries using the literal phrase 'Garsfontein Smallholdings' surfaced only existing pretoriahub.com listings (Ranyati Firearm Motivations, About IT Group -- both already published) plus more plain-Garsfontein results. Grootfontein Nursery was discarded outright as a likely false match (Grootfontein is a different, distant place name, not a Garsfontein/Smallholdings variant). Electricians, Electronics & Appliances, Engineering & Surveying, Opticians, Physiotherapists, Printing Services (a 'Multi Print Digital CC' lead was just the existing business under its full name) and Restaurants & Takeaways also found nothing suburb-specific.

Candlewoods Estate: 0 of 9 combos reached 3. Accommodation (Candlewoods Guesthouse), Attorneys (Wikus Strydom Law via Karen van Niekerk Attorneys lead -- no address evidence placing it in Candlewoods specifically), Engineering (GC Drafting Services) and Restaurants (Stoep Restaurant) candidates were all either the existing listing itself or had no suburb-specific address. Building & Construction and Engineering leads (L.E. Gator Construction, PVR Engineering Surveyors) only ever named Candlewoods as a service area, not an office address, and PVR's own contact page gives a Midrand address. Commercial Property and Schools & Education found only property-portal listing pages and generic Centurion school directories, no discrete new business. One accountants-adjacent lead, Amista Financial Solutions (Candlewoods Country Estate, via findglocal.com), was discarded: its only readable content was a personal bio built entirely around one named financial adviser, with no phone or address, so neither the verification bar nor the no-named-individual rule could be met.

Kilner Park: all 9 combos stayed short. Most crawler candidates were generic Pretoria-wide results. Discarded a Kilner Park pharmacy lead (sources disagreed on both street number and phone), Transnet Engineering - Kilner Park (a large rail workshop/corporate facility, not a public-facing engineering service, and its only phone is a shared corporate call-centre line, not pinned to this location) and Pegasus Slaghuis en Melkery (same business as the existing Pegasus Butchery, just the Afrikaans trading name).

Rooihuiskraal North / Beauty & Hair Salons closed to 3: added D'ntle Beauty Centurion (490 Theuns van Niekerk Street), a nail/beauty salon verified via its own site, Facebook and an independent booking platform (Fresha) all agreeing on the Rooihuiskraal North address. Discarded an ACDC Express Centurion lead for Electronics & Appliances: it is already a published PretoriaHub listing, filed under Hardware Stores -- re-adding it would have been a duplicate. Other Rooihuiskraal North combos checked so far (Business Consulting, Commercial Property, Electronics & Appliances, Engineering, Fuel Stations, Furniture & Homeware, General Retail) found no suburb-specific candidate; still checking Industrial Suppliers, Marketing, Pharmacies, Printing and Software Development.

Amberfield Glen: 1 of 7 combos reached 3 (engineering-surveying -- added Azimuth Surveys, 31A Peregrine Street, verified via its own site plus an independent Cybo.com listing, phone+address pinned to this branch). 6 of 7 combos stayed short: most otherwise-promising leads were killed by infobel.com, b2bhint.com and dnb.com now blocking individual listing pages behind Cloudflare/terms walls, leaving no second source to confirm name+location.

Hermanstad: 4 of 11 combos reached 3 (pharmacies: +Pharma Life (Pty) Ltd, +MediRite Courier Pharmacy; printing-services: +LM Printers; supermarkets-groceries: +Big 11; security-services: +Ps27 Security Services & Solutions, +Real Security). Also added Zuriel Cartridge And Stationery (books-stationery, 1 short), Cleaning Warehouse Hermanstad (cleaning-services, 1 short), House of Furnatics (furniture-homeware, 1 short), Ads On The Go (marketing-advertising, 1 short) and Ntswaki Investment (building-construction, 1 short) -- 11 new businesses total. Discarded ~32 of ~44 candidates reviewed: catering (0 added, 2 short) found only Pretoria-wide/other-suburb businesses; commercial-property-office-space (0 added, 1 short) found only listing-aggregator pages, not real businesses; service-area SEO pages (Tyno Cleaning, Duster Dollies, Broadway Affiliated) were excluded for having no physical Hermanstad address; DPW Construction was discarded after its confirmed address turned out to be neighbouring Daspoort (shares postal code 0082 with Hermanstad, which misled the crawler's suburb tagging). Rayetsa Furniture cleared 2-source verification but validate.mjs caught it as a duplicate: its phone already belongs to the existing business published as rayetsa-furniture-pretoria-andeon under a different suburb. pretoria.co.za was unusually reliable here, giving full address+phone+hours for 8 of the 11 accepted businesses, cross-verified via cybo.com/africabizinfo.com mirrors each time.

Clubview: 3 of 18 combos reached 3 (car-dealerships: +Hindsight Motors, +MFI Auto; general-retail: +The Queen Pet Shop; restaurants-takeaways: +Pizza Perfect Clubview, +Burger Bistro Clubview -- 3 of these found by fetching Clubview Corner mall's own tenant-directory page, a high-value source outside the original candidate list). Also added Tigers Eye Geo and Environ (engineering-surveying, 1 short), Sonja Smith Funeral Group (funeral-services, 1 short) and EMPPRO (recruitment-hr-services, 1 short) -- 8 new businesses total. 15 of 18 combos stayed short: building-construction, cleaning-services, commercial-property-office-space, marketing-advertising, software-development and supermarkets-groceries each 1 short; accountants, events-function-venues, motor-spares, security-services, solar-renewable-energy and hardware-stores each 2 short -- mostly national chains, directory listicles, or service-area SEO pages for firms actually based elsewhere (Clearview Fencing in Wierda Park Ext 2, Master Electrical in Johannesburg, Exceed IT in Olympus AH). Discarded ~63 of ~71 candidates reviewed. Self-caught risk: McCormick Media's phone resolved to a different-address 'property consultants' listing, risking confusion with the existing McCormick Property Development -- discarded proactively rather than conflate. Hardware Hub Clubview discarded for an internal data contradiction (postcode 9866/Qwaqwa vs stated Clubview/0157) in its only source.

Rietvalleirand: 4 of 13 combos reached 3 (attorneys-legal: +Jordaan Smit Inc. Attorneys & Conveyancers; electronics-appliances: +EJ's Electronics (Pty) Ltd, +KR Components SA; events-function-venues: +Ivory Manor Boutique Hotel; schools-education: +Rietvlei Akademie, +The Village Waldorf Independent Primary School). Also added DPT Printing (printing-services, 1 short) -- 7 new businesses total. 9 of 13 combos stayed at 0: accountants, building-construction, commercial-property-office-space, computer-it-services, marketing-advertising, pharmacies, restaurants-takeaways and security-services found no suburb-specific match -- mostly Pretoria/Gauteng-wide service-area SEO pages, Property24 listing pages, or wrong-suburb leads (a pharmacy candidate was actually in Riviera, not Rietvalleirand; an accountant's real address was Faerie Glen/Mooikloof). Discarded ~45 of ~53 candidates reviewed. Two duplicate/collision findings: DVP Attorneys confirmed via its own site as 'De Villiers & Pheiffer' with a matching phone -- caught and dropped before submission as a duplicate of the existing De Villiers & Pheiffer Attorneys listing; and validate.mjs caught that Austin Attorneys' own-site phone already belongs to the existing WCS Fire business -- since a second directory gave a conflicting phone number for Austin Attorneys, it was dropped entirely rather than guess which number was real. Several directories (biznizdirectory, nearfinderza, infobel) disagreed on suburb tagging for some candidates (Arcadia/Elardus Park vs Rietvalleirand), requiring 3+ sources to resolve; no search-engine contention observed for this suburb specifically -- the crawler worked reliably throughout.
